_doc: Contract between compile_vars.py (skill) and the Sarvam agent (template + code tools). Every variable listed here MUST be defined in the Sarvam agent (undefined variables are dropped by Sarvam). Written 2026-10-10. Values are strings unless noted. 2026-10-10 rev: the prompt text is per seller, in the Sarvam template sections (render_prompt.py); the skeleton app/sarvam/vani_prompt.md holds only fixed rules.

set_before_call.decision_id: run id; written into every switch_log row
set_before_call.persona_voice_gender: F | M  (drives gendered Hindi forms in identity_line / persona_style)
set_before_call.persona_language: Sarvam language name for OnStart set_initial_language_name, e.g. HINDI, GUJARATI, ENGLISH
set_before_call.persona_opening: first line spoken (initial bot message); native script; gender-agreed
set_before_call.identity_line: how VANI introduces itself if asked who is calling (per language, gender-agreed); never says AI/bot/branch manager/account manager
set_before_call.persona_style_id: P0..P6 or COMPOSED; the switch tool picks directive variants by it
set_before_call.seller_name: name token filled on premises (first name + ji) - never sent to the frontier model
set_before_call.prompt_persona: Persona section: who VANI is for this seller (gender forms, style card, tone, empathy, identity line)
set_before_call.prompt_environment: Environment & Situation: seller, company, city, what we know (personalisation), guards to respect
set_before_call.prompt_objective: Objective: division block (NSD/CSD) + this seller's hook and backup
set_before_call.prompt_style: Speaking Style: language, code-mix, words, words per reply, pace, gender forms, preserve-as-is terms
set_before_call.prompt_facts: Facts: the ONLY numbers/claims VANI may say (verified_facts) + never-say rules
set_before_call.prompt_seller: Seller block (plan 5d): states, traits, handler, named similar sellers, other-hook pointers; built by code from 01_facts.json, values only, cap 2,500 characters
set_before_call.prompt_phases: Conversation Guidelines: Phases 1-9 (identity, hook steps, ask, objections, book, close, callback, wrong person, escalation)

set_during_call_by_tools.seller_mode: neutral | rushed | frustrated | confused | interested | bot_question | opt_out | language_switch
set_during_call_by_tools.switch_log: JSON list of rows {t, turn, utt, lang, from, to, cue, directive_id, change, reason, ms}; never shown to the LLM
set_during_call_by_tools.meeting_slot: natural-language slot the seller agreed (set by book_meeting tool)

set_after_call_by_sarvam._doc: Sarvam post-interaction variables (update_post_interaction=true). Cheap per-call labels for the loops; the frontier review (08_review.json) is the judge and may disagree.

call_outcome.prompt: How did the call end? meeting_booked only if the seller agreed a day and time.

main_objection.prompt: The seller's main objection, if any.

hook_reaction.prompt: How did the seller react to the first reason VANI gave for the call (the hook)?

persona_fit.prompt: The biggest problem with how VANI spoke to this seller, or good if none.

seller_mood_end.prompt: The seller's mood at the end of the call.

end_language.prompt: The language the seller spoke at the end of the call (one word, e.g. Telugu, Hindi).
